newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 11.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Former President Valery Giscard d'Estaing in an interview calls on Prime Minister Lionel Jospin to cut public deficits to three percent of GDP as early as 1997, warns a failure to join a European single currency would be dangerous for France.
-- Arms maker Colt's Manufacturing may buy a 92 percent stake in Belgium's Herstal from French arms manufacturer Giat Industries.
-- Credit Lyonnais cut some 4,700 jobs without layoffs over the last three years, staff is now reluctant to take advantage of early retirement offers.
-- Eurotunnel shares rose by 11 percent at opening on Friday after shareholders had voted in favour of the financial restructuring prospectus.
